sql:
SELECT n.notice_no, n.notice_title, DATE(n.noticedate) AS noticedate,
			n.is_important, u.name AS username
		FROM notice n
		LEFT JOIN user u ON u.usernum = n.usernum
		WHERE 1 = 1
		 
		 
			AND n.notice_title LIKE CONCAT('%', ?, '%')
		 
		ORDER BY n.is_important DESC, n.notice_no DESC
		LIMIT ?, 10
